item: 1 Double brick walls, floor and lintels
spec: About 2,000 fired bricks for two 115 mm leaves (outer 3.01 x 2.11 m, 2.1 m high) with a brick capping course over the cavity and a brick floor on a sand bed; about 0.6 m3 of cement-sand mortar; about 40 galvanized wire wall ties; four termite-treated hardwood lintels 115 x 100 mm (two 1.14 m over the door, two 0.94 m over the pad opening)
notes: Indicative: bricks about $0.06 each ($120), mortar about $40, lintels about $12, wall ties about $4; mason's labor not included. Lintels and ties priced from ZBX-DDR-003. Structure, costed separately from the kit (ZBX-DDR-001 item 1)

spec: About 1.3 m3 of dry rice husk in the 75 mm cavity (ZBX-CAL-001), mixed with hydrated lime against insects, on a plastic damp-proof course at the base, capped with a mortar course at the top and closed with 6 mm galvanized mesh at any opening
supplier: Local rice mill and hardware shop
notes: Indicative price (husk often free at the mill; lime, mesh and damp-proof sheet about $15). Decided in place of wet sand (ZBX-DDR-002, item 12); fall back to dry sand if no durable, pest-proof husk supply exists locally. Structure, costed separately

spec: Nine 50 x 100 mm joists 2.11 m long across the wall tops (two of them 360 mm apart to take the fan box), 25 x 25 mm cleats nailed along their sides, 50 mm straw board or foam board laid on the cleats with a plastic vapor sheet, 20 mm boards nailed over the joists; galvanized straps holding each joist end to the wall
notes: Indicative material cost (timber about $55, insulation, sheet and straps about $15); repriced for the framed ceiling of ZBX-DDR-003. Structure, costed separately

item: 4 Shade roof: sheets, posts and footings
spec: Corrugated galvanized steel sheets covering 3.9 x 3.0 m, screwed to the purlins with sealing-washer roofing screws; four 89 mm galvanized steel pipe posts with a welded 150 x 150 x 6 mm cap plate set to the roof slope, each cast 450 mm into a 500 x 500 x 600 mm concrete footing (uplift, ZBX-CAL-001)
notes: Indicative: sheets and posts about $50, cap plates about $8, about 0.6 m3 of concrete for the footings about $20. Structure, costed separately

spec: Door leaf 794 x 1,792 x 50 mm (0.8 x 1.8 m nominal): timber frame, plywood skins, 50 mm insulation, three 100 mm butt hinges, inside release latch with no outside lock; opens outward
notes: Indicative material cost; must open from inside without a key. Lining and stops are line 16. Structure, costed separately

spec: 150 mm cellulose evaporative pad 0.6 x 0.5 m (0.3 m2); frame of 25 mm treated boards on two 25 x 50 mm wall battens; two 30 x 3 mm galvanized support bars and two retaining bars; 20 mm board lining for the wall opening; perforated 32 mm PVC drip header with end cap; galvanized return gutter 170 x 60 mm on two strip brackets, with a 32 mm outlet
supplier: Poultry or greenhouse equipment supplier; local carpenter
notes: Indicative price (pad about $30, frame, lining, bars and brackets about $10, header and gutter about $10); 150 mm decided in place of 100 mm (ZBX-DDR-002, item 11); frame details from ZBX-DDR-003

spec: 60 L covered plastic drum, 12 V DC submersible pump about 6 W and 2 m head, float switch, feed and return hoses
supplier: Local market and solar or pump supplier

spec: 250 mm 12 V DC axial fan, about 12 W and about 400 m3/h free air, with finger guards both faces and gravity shutter; mounted blowing upward on the ceiling fan box (ZBX-DDR-003)
notes: Indicative price; delivered airflow about 290 m3/h each at about 16 Pa (ZBX-CAL-001, assumed linear fan curve); confirm with the fan's curve

spec: Low-cost microcontroller board, two digital temperature and RH sensors (one in a radiation shield outside), MOSFET fan and pump drivers, memory card logger, three-color mode lamp, IP65 box
150 W monocrystalline, about 1,480 x 670 x 35 mm, Vmp about 18 V, Isc about 9 A, with frame mounting holes on the back flange
notes: Indicative price; 150 W decided (ZBX-DDR-001 item 2); mounting frames are line 18

notes: Indicative price (battery about $40, controller about $12); battery kept (ZBX-DDR-001 item 3)
